mapping_rationale.fresh_good_grade1_fruits360: Mapped to 0 (Healthy): Represents pristine fruits without observable physical, fungal, or structural defects.
mapping_rationale.mild_grade2: Mapped to 1 (Mild Defect): Represents minor surface blemishes, slight discoloration, or commercial grade 2 fruits suitable for retail with minor visual flaws.
mapping_rationale.mixed: Mapped to 2 (Moderate Defect): Represents moderate quality degradation, heterogeneous surface defects, or intermediate quality tier.
mapping_rationale.bad_grade3: Mapped to 3 (Severe Defect): Represents major physical damage, processing grade 3 quality, or structural deterioration requiring immediate processing.
mapping_rationale.rotten: Mapped to 4 (Rotten): Represents advanced biological decay, fungal colonization, active necrosis, and complete loss of commercial utility.

exclusions.Banana_3rd_grade: Excluded (n=2): Insufficient sample size for statistically valid train/val/test stratification.
